blocks.arabic_text: وَإِلَي النَّجَاشِيِّ، وَإِلي كُلِّ جَبَّارٍ، يَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَي اللهِ تَعَالَي، وَلَيْسَ بِالنَّجَاشِيِّ الَّذِي صَلَّي عَلَيْهِ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم، باب كتب النبي ﷺ إلي ملوك الكفار...، رقم:٤٦٠٩
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Anas (RA) narrates, “The Prophet ﷺ wrote letters to Kisra, Qaisar, Najashi and to every emperor; he wrote the letters inviting them towards Allah Ta'ala. This is not the Najashi (who became a Muslim and) over whom Rasulullah ﷺ performed the Janazah Salah,” rather this was another Najashi (the title of every king of Abyssinia used to be called “Najashi”).

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ اْلعُرْسِ بْنِ عَمِيرَةَ اْلكِنْدَيِّ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: إِذَا عُمِلَتِ الْخَطِيئَةُ فِي اْلاَرْضِ كَانَ مَنْ شَهِدَهَا فَكَرِهَهَا كَانَ كَمَنْ غَابَ عَنْهَا، وَمَنْ غَابَ عَنْهَا فَرَضِيَهَا كَانَ كَمَنْ شَهِدَهَا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابو داؤد، باب الامر والنهي، رقم: ٤٣٤٥
blocks.tamil_translation: “When any sin is committed on the earth, if a person sees it and regards it as evil, he will be protected from the evil like a person who was not present where that sin took place. And if a person who was not present where that sin took place does not regard that sin as evil, he becomes a partner in the evil like the one who was present where the sin occurred.” Hazrat Urs ibn Amirah Kindi (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ جَابِرٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: مََثَلِي وَمَثَلُكُمْ كَمَثَلِ رَجُلٍ أَوْقَدَ نَارًا، فَجَعَل الْجَنَادِبُ وَالْفَرَاشُ يَقَعْنَ فِيهَا، وَهُوَ يَذُبُّهُنَّ عَنْهَا، وَأَنَا آخِذٌ بِحُجَزِكُمْ عَنِ النَّارِ، وَأَنْتُمْ تُفَلِّتُونَ مِنْ يَدِي.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم، باب شفقته ﷺ علي امته....، رقم:٥٩٥٨
blocks.tamil_translation: “The example of me and you is like that of a man who lit a fire, and when grasshoppers and moths began to come and fall into it, he kept driving them away
